A tall elegant floating citadel of ivory stone, pale blue rooftops, terraced gardens, narrow arched skybridges, a central domed observatory and slender spires, a small waterfall dissipating into mist below. The rocky underside is elongated with hanging roots. Overall silhouette vertical and soaring. Restrained cool blue, white, sandstone, small warm amber lights. No giant airship, no characters.
